== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]]: the region (500, 812, 628, 860) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]] (PC-E1): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/103874657ec982c3002d76f0fe3347388d73f573/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif Holotable commit 1038746] (2024-07-25). The matching before crop is [[:File:V23-L-passagetothealderaansystem-2024-07-25-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Passage To The Alderaan System]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif commit 335d47f]) and [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/103874657ec982c3002d76f0fe3347388d73f573/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif commit 1038746]).
